description: This Java class 'GatewayCachingSignalEnrichmentProvider' provides a gateway service for signal enrichment facades using an asynchronous Caffeine cache to load additional data for enrichment. It implements caching logic to optimize signal enrichment requests through an internal facade and is instantiated via reflection.

classes.name: GatewayCachingSignalEnrichmentProvider
classes.description: A provider class for signal enrichment facades with caching, utilizing Akka actor system dispatchers for async cache loading.

methods.name: GatewayCachingSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache facade with a cache loader provider and dispatcher executor.

methods.name: getFacade
methods.description: Returns the cached SignalEnrichmentFacade for a given HttpRequest.
